authority: User $implement docs/features/core-workbench request; approved PLAN p2.6 CW-15; fresh review findings
objective: Correct the ended-run command admission and metadata-gated periodic review defects without changing the production binding architecture.
required_changes: Use one shared automatic-admission predicate for command dispatch and periodic review. It must require a reconciled ready/running state for the current run, current boot/session/owner/control evidence, no problems, automation authorization and MetadataAdmissionGate.automatic_runs_allowed.

If reconcile reports state=ended/fully terminated, dispatch_command must not fence or deliver a bound message even when OMP/shell peers remain alive and problems is empty; return a clear held/ended outcome and preserve durable no-replay state.

tick must not call PauseCoordinator.dispatch_automatic or WorkerReviewScheduler.tick while metadata automatic admission is false, boot confirmation is pending, run is ended/unknown, or other shared admission conditions fail. Explicit durable metadata success may reopen later ticks.

Add focused regressions for ended-run command hold and metadata failure -> zero review calls -> explicit success -> one allowed tick, while preserving model-error, pause, positive delivery and shutdown behavior.
constraints: Bounded correction only; do not modify predecessor packages, docs, PLAN, state or ledger. No new architecture, external OMP, reboot, delegation, commit, publish, deploy or Docker.
Use apply_patch; run lifecycle and relevant regressions, graphify update and residue check.
report: Return candidate_ready/needs_reroute, shared admission invariant, exact command/delivery/review counts, suites/residue, hashes/scope and pending environment items.
